bounded_host_request.command: docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -A -t -c "SELECT coalesce(s.chat_id::text,'none') AS pinned_chat,coalesce(m.feature,'none') AS menu_feature,coalesce(d.data->>'destinationExplicit','none') AS explicit_flag,coalesce(d.data->>'selectedTopicId','none') AS saved_topic,CASE WHEN s.chat_id IS NOT NULL AND s.expires_at>now() THEN 'active' ELSE 'inactive' END AS pinned_session,coalesce((SELECT count(*)::text FROM posting_deliveries x JOIN announcement_posts a ON a.announcement_id::text=x.source_id AND x.source_type='announcement' JOIN room_posts r ON r.room_id=a.room_id WHERE r.owner_user_id=d.owner_user_id),'0') AS linked_deliveries FROM public_post_drafts d LEFT JOIN topic_dm_entry_sessions s ON s.owner_user_id=d.owner_user_id LEFT JOIN board_menu_sessions m ON m.owner_user_id=d.owner_user_id WHERE d.module='room' AND d.step='preview'"
